data.jobspec:
#!/bin/sh
# Flux batch script converted from PBS

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# PBS resources:
#   -q i1accs
#   -l select=1:ncpus=64:mpiprocs=1:ompthreads=1
#   -l walltime=00:15:00
#   -N GCNLMP

# Map to Flux: 1 node, 1 task, 64 cores, 15 minutes.
#flux: --job-name=GCNLMP
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 64
#flux: --time-limit=15m

# Omitted PBS option: -q i1accs (queue)
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may run with different limits/priority or be rejected by policy.

module purge
module load openmpi_nvhpc/4.1.2
module load nvhpc-nompi/22.2_cuda11.6

source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate nequip_GPU2

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0"

./lmp -in input.data

reasons: PBS specified a queue (`-q i1accs`) but the Flux resource section has no queue/partition selection; on sites where this affects eligibility/limits, scheduling behavior may differ or the job may be rejected.
